name: Multi-CB design parameters (35 um copper)
notes: Values for 35 um copper, from the design-parameters table ('Standard (min.)' and 'Special production (min.)') and the KiCad page (https://www.multi-circuit-boards.eu/en/support/pcb-data/kicad.html), which marks the standard values free of charge. Other copper thicknesses: ask Multi-CB.
The KiCad page gives 0.1 mm as the smallest possible via drill; the design-parameters table gives 150 um for special production. The table's 150 um is used.
Component holes: annular ring + 25 um. Laser blind vias (microvias) only in special production, with a data check first.
Not stated and therefore not checked: hole-to-hole spacing, non-plated hole minimum, layer count, board thickness, board size, silkscreen minimum.

microvias.note: laser blind vias are special production

levels.label: Special production
levels.note: Finer than standard; see Multi-CB's prices for special production.
